title: ICAR Launches AI-Based 'Oilseeds Kisaan Mitra' WhatsApp Chatbot (+91 4024598180)
summary: Provides multilingual research-backed advisory to oilseed farmers directly on mobile phones.

blocks.content: Provides multilingual research-backed advisory to oilseed farmers directly on mobile phones.

items: AI Chatbot: Developed by ICAR-Indian Institute of Oilseeds Research (ICAR-IIOR), Hyderabad.
Farmer Guidance: Responds instantly in any Indian language on crop management, seed selection, and pest control.
Import Dependency: India imports 55-60% of its edible oil requirement (~16 million tonnes at ₹1.32 lakh crore).
